proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal to Prohibit Vesting of Equity Awards Upon Entering Government Service
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a policy prohibiting vesting of equity awards for senior executives upon voluntary resignation to enter government service.
proposals.evidence: OUR BOARD UNANIMOUSLY RECOMMENDS A VOTE AGAINST THE SHAREHOLDER PROPOSAL.

proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal to Change the Vote Counting Standard for Shareholder Proposals
proposals.proponent: Equality Network Foundation and United Church Funds
proposals.topic_summary: Requests amending governing documents so nonbinding shareholder proposals are decided by simple majority of votes cast FOR and AGAINST, excluding abstentions.
proposals.evidence: OUR BOARD UNANIMOUSLY RECOMMENDS A VOTE AGAINST THE SHAREHOLDER PROPOSAL.

proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal to Require an Independent Board Chairman
proposals.proponent: James McRitchie and Myra K. Young
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a policy requiring the Board Chair, whenever possible, to be an independent director.
proposals.evidence: OUR BOARD UNANIMOUSLY RECOMMENDS A VOTE AGAINST THE SHAREHOLDER PROPOSAL.
